proposals.before: In 211, when Guanzhong fell into chaos, Liu Kuo of Fufeng fled into Hanzhong, bought Shan, learned he came from a respectable family, and raised him as his own son, marrying him off and fathering a grandson.
proposals.after: In 211, when Guanzhong fell into chaos, Liu Kuo of Fufeng fled into Hanzhong, bought Shan, learned he came from a respectable family, raised him as his own son, gave him a wife, and Shan fathered a son.
proposals.reason: Chinese 與娶婦，生一子 means Liu Kuo arranged Shan's marriage and Shan then had a son; 'fathering a grandson' obscures the subject of 生.

decisions.reason: The subject of 生一子 is Liu Shan: Liu Kuo arranged his marriage, after which Shan had a son. The existing wording incorrectly makes Liu Kuo father the child.
